Research

Source: vignettes/publication.Rmd
publication.Rmd

Here, we archive relevant publications and research documents using data from the legisTaiwan R package, Legislative Yuan API, or raw data from the Taiwan Legislative Yuan Library.

Rollcall Votes 記名投票

2024 Yen-Chieh Liao Electoral Reform and Fragmented Polarization: New Evidence from Taiwan Legislative Roll Call. Legislative Studies Quarterly. 50(1): 3-21. [DOI:https://doi.org/10.1111/lsq.12459]

2018 Jinhyeok Jang and Nick Lin Personal Votes, Electoral Competitiveness of Parties, and Legislative Representation in Taiwan under SNTV. Japanese Journal of Political Science. 20(1): 21-32. [DOI:https://doi.org/10.1017/S1468109918000397]

Interpellations 院會（或委員會）質詢

2025 王奕婷 〈台灣國會政黨如何論述中國議題？〉，《人文及社會科學集刊》， 第37卷 (forthcoming)。

2025 Yen-Chieh Liao, Yu-Ceng Liao and Yi-ting Wang Electoral Reform and Issue Attention in Legislative Oversight: From SNTV to Mixed-Member Majoritarian System in Taiwan. unpublished working paper

2024 黃士豪〈文本分析的基礎建設：臺灣國會研究詞庫的建置與測試〉，《台灣政治學刊》，第27卷，第1期：119-177。

2023 Isaac S. H. Huang Constituency Influence and Parliamentary Oversight Under Covid-19 Pandemic Experience from Taiwan. Taiwan Journal of Democracy. 19(1): 73-97.

Written Questions 專案質詢

2025 Yen-Chieh Liao and Li Tang Electoral Systems and Geographically-Targeted Oversight: Evidence from Taiwan Legislative Yuan. Electoral Studies. (Forthcoming)

2025 廖育嶒 〈選舉制度改革與立委的代表行為：第五屆與第七屆專案書面質詢的分析〉，《東吳政治學報》，第40卷，第1期：75-143。

2022 Yu-Ceng Liao Party Leadership, Electoral Reform and Mandate-divide. Japanese Journal of Political Science 23(3): 209-230. [DOI:10.1017/S1468109922000111]
